_comment: The one place for names and links. tools/build.py fills the {{...}} placeholders in src/ with these values; a value may use other placeholders. APP_NAME is the name in the Odoo Apps store: max 25 characters, no company name, no 'Odoo'. NAME_FINAL false makes tools/build.py release refuse to write the store branches. WEBSITE: the TimeViking site (later the Odoo landing page).
SUMMARY: {{PRODUCT_NAME}}: weekly and mobile timesheets (calendar, grid, timer, quick entry) synced two-way with Odoo Timesheets. Free up to 3 users
AUTHOR: Software Services BV
